items.title: Fast Money Host Warns Hyperscaler CapEx Binge Is ‘Issuing Near Junk’ as Data Center Buildout Shows Cracks
items.summary: A Fast Money host is sounding alarms that the AI buildout is quietly cracking under the weight of debt that even the bond market seems reluctant to absorb, and the ripple effects could reach far beyond Silicon Valley balance sheets.

items.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Q2 Spurs Analyst Target Hikes
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Delta Air Lines has shifted from US$81.81 to US$105.52, a change of about 29% that moves closer to the higher end of recent Street price target ranges. Analysts linking this move to Delta’s recent Q2 results and commentary point to execution on earnings, margin structure, and the role of premium and loyalty driven revenue streams in supporting the updated targets. items.title: American Airlines Revenue Reset Gains Traction Despite Fuel Risks
